msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Hi! Completing your Open Water certification with your referral is a great way to finish your training in the Rosario Islands. Just to clarify, the refresher is for already-certified divers who haven’t dived in over two years; the mini-course is a try-dive and doesn’t count toward your PADI certification. If you need a refresher, it’s booked as the Dive Mini Course.

The referral course requires an overnight stay on the islands; accommodation isn’t included.

For two people, please select the quantities in the booking links; the checkout will show the exact total:
- Open Water Referral Course: https://divingplanet.org/curso-padi-cartagena/referido/

The referral course requires the PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is the “Open Water Referral Course,” not a regular dive trip.

You’ll need your referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Absolutely! For the most convenient access to diving, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—both are our dive bases, and pick-up is direct.

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up can be arranged from these hotels too, depending on their boat access. Accommodation isn’t included in the diving plans, so you’ll book directly with the hotel.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and drop-off are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Would you like me to share the booking link for the Open Water Referral Course when you’ve chosen your dates?

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?
reply:
That sounds like a lovely plan! We operate every day except December 25 and January 1, weather permitting, so Easter Sunday is included. The booking calendar will let you choose April 5 and 6.

Just a quick note: the refresher is booked as the *Dive Mini Course*. Since you’ll be staying on the islands, it’s *$134 USD per person online* (the online price includes the 10% discount), and you book and pay through the website:

Book the Dive Mini Course from the islands: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

A refresher and a certified diver can go together on the same outing.

The refresher is a one-day review with pool practice and one ocean dive. If you’re planning it for the day before your referral dives, choose that date in the booking calendar. Would you like the link for the Open Water Referral Course as well?
